test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The average of 11 consecutive numbers is 30. The smallest number among these is:
solution:
**Given:**

Average of 11 consecutive numbers = 30

Number of terms = 11

**Formula Used:**

Average = (Sum of all terms) / (Number of terms)

Smallest number = Average - (Number of terms - 1) / 2

**Calculation:**

Sum of all terms = Average × Number of terms

⇒ Sum = 30 × 11

⇒ Sum = 330

Smallest number = Average - (Number of terms - 1) / 2

⇒ Smallest number = 30 - (11 - 1) / 2

⇒ Smallest number = 30 - 10 / 2

⇒ Smallest number = 30 - 5

⇒ Smallest number = 25

**The smallest number among these is 25.**
